liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Cold Rain And Snow** (2 reviews): Bruce played a few bars of a rain-themed pop tune beforehand, nodding to rare California rain; Reviewer's favorite Cold Rain of all time [12][20]
- **Black Throated Wind** (1 review): Reviewer became enamored of this version when getting a first copy in 1991 [14]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Reviewer had a trippy moment here, imagining the band and audience as one giant green caterpillar [12]

## The recordings

- **gd1991-08-14.150320.sbd.miller.flac2496** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 170 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1991-08-14.137920.sbd.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 173 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1991-08-14.sbd.hinko.30073.sbeok.flacf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 171 min; rated 3.57/5 by 14 [3]. Said about its sound: This soundboard sounds great; the other circulating 'soundboard' is really a nice audience recording [20]
- **gd91-08-14.sbd.oconnor.9798.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 170 min; rated 2.91/5 by 10 [4]. Said about its sound: The reviewer's own tape from the tapers section was ruined by constant wind gusts; A front-of-board tape the reviewer has heard also suffers from wind gusts, so the soundboard is welcome; The first few seconds of Cold Rain and Snow appear to be cut from this tape [11][12][14][18][19]
- **gd1991-08-14.148407.fob.BK4011.ebel.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 169 min [8]. Said about its sound: Conversation is audible at the start of Looks Like Rain, and mics seem lowered for part of it [8]
- **gd1991-08-14.143089.FOB.s2.Schoeps.unknown.Dalton.Miller.Noel.t-flac1644**: source not stated; 13 songs; 115 min [10]. Said about its sound: The first set has dozens of dropouts in its first 20 minutes, leaving a persistent digital-noise murmur [10]

## Around the show

- Tapers were unprepared for the rain; some covered their microphones with garbage bags [11]
- It rained in usually dry Sacramento, and the band acknowledged it with a rain-themed run of songs opening the second set [16]
- Cal Expo admission included the property's water slide; it was discontinued after this year over LSD safety worries, an employee said [16]
- Reviewer attended, got soaked, and heard three rain songs in a row [22]
- Uploader notes this was their last Cal Expo show [10]
- Reviewer calls the rain-themed second set the favorite of the strong Expo-Shoreline run [20]
- Three consecutive rain songs was a first in the reviewer's 25 years of Dead shows [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1991-08-14.150320.sbd.miller.flac2496**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  July 2, 2020; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [1]. Also: Front-of-board, split 12-foot Schoeps MK2 recording, to master DAT then PCM, taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; Uncle John's Band section from 3:30 to 4:08 is patched from shnid 143089 [1]
- **gd1991-08-14.137920.sbd.flac16**: taped by PO and Stucco TINA Holmes; transferred by Mastering and editing by acetboy; source: DAT Master SBDs no transfer info > Sony L-750ESX-HFB Dynamicron EXCELLENT SUPER HIFI VIDEO CASSETTE-> Sony SLO-1800 STEREO VIDEOCASSETTE RECORDER-> Sony… [2]. Also: SHN 119121 supplied a brief patch in track 8 and the complete track 14 [2]
- **gd1991-08-14.sbd.hinko.30073.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Darryl Hinko; source: flac16 SBD > DAT > C > DAT > CD > EAC > FLAC; EAC/FLAC [3]
- **gd91-08-14.sbd.oconnor.9798.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>DAT>??>DAT>CDR [4]. Also: Reviewer's own DAT>cassette>DAT soundboard copy lacked the first set [13]
- **gd1991-08-14.148407.fob.BK4011.ebel.flac16**: transferred by Pete Ebel; source: FOB B&K 4011-> Sony D10 Pro II-> DAT [8]. Also: Knockin' On Heaven's Door was missing from the source tape; Schoeps MK2 source 143089 filled it; Uploader guesses the source tape is by Clay Brennecke and Jamie Young [8]
- **gd1991-08-14.143089.FOB.s2.Schoeps.unknown.Dalton.Miller.Noel.t-flac1644**: taped by Tim Dalton; transferred by Charlie Miller and Joe Noel; source: Set 2 Unknown taper: FOB Schoeps Omni MK2 (spaced 12') > Oade Custom Pre Amp > Panasonic SV-255 > Master DAT > PCM; Charlie Miller [10]. Also: Schoeps front-of-board source, patched from shnid 113427 (Neumann KMF 4), using Tim Dalton's PCM transfer [10]
